audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike wrote 'His R Devour/Abyssal Dive' as if they were one ability, and gave no cooldown for either.
audit.why: Devour is the R; Abyssal Dive is the W, a 21/20/19/18/17s knock-up reposition. Merging them told the player one cooldown governs both, when only the W has one worth tracking.
audit.corrected: Devour and Abyssal Dive separated, with the W's 21s rank-1 cooldown stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. 'Acquired Taste' is written where the ability is An Acquired Taste. Grey health is attributed to his W in four places — it is Thick Skin, the E. And the page treats three stacks as only a stun threat.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: damaging champions builds An Acquired Taste, and at three stacks he can use Devour on an enemy champion. So the stacks gate the R, not just the Q stun — denying them denies the ability that removes you from a fight entirely. Thick Skin is the grey-health mechanic: it passively stores a percentage of damage taken and heals from it out of combat, and its active converts the stored damage into a shield on a 3-second cooldown, which is why Grievous Wounds decides extended trades here.
audit.corrected: Three An Acquired Taste stacks is a Tongue Lash stun and a Devour — deny the stacks and he gets neither. Thick Skin (E), not the W, banks grey health and cashes it as a shield every 3 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect is right — no cooldown numbers anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns called Abyssal Dive 'his escape + shield'.
audit.why: The shield is Thick Skin. Abyssal Dive is 21s at rank 1; Tongue Lash is 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s at 900 range and heals him when it strikes a champion.
audit.corrected: All three clocks written into breakdown.cooldowns.
